tendo.name: Tendo Food Map
tendo.hero_title:
Explore the flavors of Tendo,
 one pin on the map at a time.
tendo.description: A food guide to Tendo, the town of shogi and hot springs, with every eatery pinned on a map.
tendo.subtitle: Stories about the tastes of Tendo, collected on a map
tendo.about: A food guide to eateries in Tendo, Yamagata, based on social posts by visitors, presented together with a map. Cover images are AI-created watercolor illustrations; see the embedded original posts for actual photos of the food.
